name: Vámosszabadi (Hungary)
description: Dark blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vámosszabadi: a white and blue shield with a yellow lion and a stag, within a yellow wreath, above a scroll inscribed VÁMOSSZABADI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vámosszabadi arms with wreath and scroll
